node.title: Re: RT::Client turns occasional binary characters in to wide characters
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I also suspect that this is some encoding problem, but my suspicion is the problem happens before [mod://RT::Client::REST] even hands you the data, and the display of the data with [mod://Data::HexDump] is just a symptom - use [doc://Devel::Peek] to really see what Perl is storing internally, maybe you could show that here. I haven't had a chance to look at the issue in detail myself, partly because I haven't yet found an RT ticket with a binary attachment to play with.

I see you reported [rt://127288|#127288], but did you have a look at [rt://90112|#90112], which seems to discuss a similar issue?

Just an idea, perhaps you could attach an example file that reproduces the issue to [rt://127288|#127288]? (Or, maybe someone knows of an RT issue with a binary attachment off the top of their head.)
